subject: Kalyani Forge — advance against invoice INV-88123
body:
Dear Rohit,

Kindly note that we need to release an advance of Rs 6,40,000 against invoice INV-88123 from Kalyani Forge Components for the Q2 die order. PO 4471 covers this. Please revert with the NEFT confirmation once processed.

Best regards,
Ananya

subject: Sundaram Freight — September settlement
body:
Dear Priya,

Please process the Sundaram Freight settlement of Rs 32,00,000 for the September consignment note. The customs papers are attached for your approval. I have verified the freight ledger against PO 3312.

Best regards,
Ananya

subject: Payroll pool — August release
body:
Dear Rohit,

The August payroll release to the employee pool stands at Rs 2,38,40,000. Kindly note the bank has already debited the escrow. Please revert if the NEFT batch number differs from the ledger.

Best regards,
Ananya

subject: GST reconciliation — vendor master
body:
Dear Priya,

For your approval: the GST reconciliation for Kalyani Forge and Sundaram is closed for August. I found a Rs 42,000 input credit mismatch on the freight leg. Please revert with the corrected credit note before EOD Friday.

Best regards,
Ananya

subject: Sundaram — customs penalty
body:
Dear Rohit,

Kindly note Sundaram has levied a customs penalty of Rs 28,00,000 on the Chennai clearance. The amount is within the freight contract. Please process by NEFT today so the demurrage stops accruing. Please revert once done.

Best regards,
Ananya

subject: Zenith Marine — supplies order
body:
Dear Priya,

Please add Zenith Marine Supplies as an approved vendor for the Kochi yard order, value Rs 18,50,000. Their GST and PAN documents are on file with procurement. Kindly note this needs finance sign-off only.

Best regards,
Ananya

subject: Kalyani Forge — revised advance schedule
body:
Dear Rohit,

Kalyani Forge has requested the advance schedule be revised to Rs 9,50,000 per die set against PO 4471. The commercial terms are unchanged. Please revert with the payment calendar before the vendors meeting on Thursday.

Best regards,
Ananya

subject: Audit query — RTGS confirmations
body:
Dear Priya,

Kindly note the statutory auditors need RTGS confirmations for all payments above Rs 50,00,000 made in the June quarter. Please revert with the bank statement extracts. For your approval, I have marked the relevant ledger pages.

Best regards,
Ananya
